name: escalation-offline-recovery
objective: Close only demonstrated offline migration/ambiguous-result gaps while preserving existing scoped governed replay and escalation lifecycle.
truthOwner: DSH owns governed operational mutations; the mobile queue is transport durability, never alternate business truth.

tasks.objective: Close demonstrated offline data-loss or ambiguous-result gaps without replacing the existing governed field replay queue.
tasks.currentProblem: The working v2 queue removes legacy v1 storage without demonstrated lossless migration, and ambiguous server-result reconciliation is not directly proven for governed DSH replay.
tasks.requiredChange: Add direct queue/sync tests, implement safe legacy migration/quarantine and server readback reconciliation only for reproduced gaps, preserving operation scope/idempotency/backoff.
tasks.targetState: No authorized pending field mutation is silently lost on upgrade/restart, no ambiguous result is blindly duplicated, and stale/wrong-actor queued work cannot replay.
tasks.action: Build deterministic storage/network tests around field-offline-queue/use-field-offline-sync; migrate legacy records transactionally or quarantine with explicit recovery and reconcile ambiguous outcomes using canonical server truth before unsafe retry where needed.
mustNotChange: Do not create one queue per screen.
Do not drop pending legacy data silently.
Do not treat local queue state as DSH truth.
acceptanceCriteria: Legacy pending records migrate or are explicitly quarantined without silent loss.
Wrong actor/installation/store cannot replay queued work.
Ambiguous results reconcile before unsafe retry.
Direct tests cover all four governed operation types.
tasks.rollback: Forward-fix data durability; never roll back by deleting queued work or weakening scope/idempotency.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused offline durability/reconciliation commit after direct tests pass.
